# Palm Beach Dentist - Dr. Mitchell Josephs

> A comprehensive dental practice website for Dr. Mitchell Josephs offering cosmetic, restorative, and specialized dental services in Palm Beach, Florida.

Dr. Mitchell A. Josephs operates a full-service dental practice in Palm Beach serving the local community and beyond. The site features extensive patient education, professional credentials, and community outreach programs including pro bono services for Holocaust survivors.
